title: Red Dead Redemption 2 Has A Boat Named Leonida
sources: Daily Dot: RDR2 / GTA 6 Leonida boat texture
OpenCritic: Red Dead Redemption 2 almost included a reference to GTA 6
GamePro.de: RDR2 player finds possible GTA 6 easter egg after over 7 years
iXBT (28 Jan 2026): RDR2 files reference to GTA VI

lines.text: Red Dead Redemption 2 has an unused boat texture named The Leonida.
Yes, Leonida, the fictional state GTA 6 is set in.
A speedrunner called SonekaSpeedruns found it in the game files, years after launch.
The texture lists ship names, like The Emily Bell, Moses T Prescott, and The Leonida.
Red Dead 2 came out in twenty eighteen.
Was Rockstar planning a GTA 6 tease back then? Nobody knows, and Rockstar has never said so.
It could just be a name they liked, so for now it's only a fan theory.
So tell us below, was that boat just a boat, or is it a secret hiding inside
